title_templates.text: Scheduled Maintenance Job
title_templates.description: Attend site and carry out the scheduled maintenance for the assets listed. Complete the service checklist, replace consumables and report any defect requiring a follow-up quotation.

title_templates.text: Urgent - Cockroach sighting in main kitchen
title_templates.description: Kitchen staff reported multiple German cockroach sightings around the dishwashing area and under the prep counters during the evening shift. Immediate gel baiting and a full harbourage inspection are required ahead of the scheduled NEA inspection.

title_templates.text: Bt Scheduled Maintenance Job
title_templates.description: Attend site and carry out the scheduled maintenance for the assets listed. Complete the service checklist, replace consumables and report any defect requiring a follow-up quotation.

title_templates.text: Fly ingress at loading bay
title_templates.description: High fly counts recorded on the insect light traps nearest the loading bay. Drain treatment and an air curtain assessment are recommended.

title_templates.text: Ant trails in server room
title_templates.description: Persistent ant trails observed entering the server room via the cable riser. Non-residual, low-odour treatment required due to sensitive equipment.

title_templates.text: Bed bug complaint from guest room
title_templates.description: A guest reported bites and live specimens were confirmed on the mattress seam in the affected room. Adjacent rooms need inspection and the block should be scheduled for heat treatment.

title_templates.text: Bird nesting above main entrance canopy
title_templates.description: Pigeons are nesting above the main entrance canopy and guano is fouling the walkway below. Netting and spike installation is required, plus a guano clean-down and biocide wash.

title_templates.text: Post-renovation disinfection request
title_templates.description: Following renovation works, the client requests full ULV disinfection of the affected floor before staff return, with a certificate of disinfection for their records.

title_templates.text: Stored product insects in flour pallets
title_templates.description: Weevils found in flour pallets during a routine stock check. Pheromone monitoring and a fumigation assessment of the affected bay are required.

title_templates.text: Termite mud tubes on basement wall
title_templates.description: Facility team observed mud tubing along the basement retaining wall near the pump room. Requires moisture metering, activity confirmation and a corrective soil treatment quotation.

title_templates.text: Mosquito breeding complaint from NEA
title_templates.description: NEA issued a notice following a dengue cluster within 150m of the premises. All stagnant water points must be treated and a breeding-site audit submitted within 48 hours.

title_templates.text: Rodent droppings found in dry store
title_templates.description: Droppings and gnaw marks were found on packaging in the dry goods store. Suspected ingress via the loading bay shutter gap. Requires trapping, proofing assessment and a stock contamination check.

title_templates.description: Attend site to investigate the reported breakdown. Diagnose the fault, restore service where possible on the first visit, and raise a parts request if a return visit is required.

title_templates.text: Chemical Treatment Job
title_templates.description: Carry out the chemical treatment at the site locations listed. Record the product used, batch number, dosage and areas treated, and advise the customer of any re-entry period.

title_templates.text: Installation Job
title_templates.description: Attend site to install and commission the supplied equipment. Confirm mounting position with the customer, test on completion and obtain sign-off before leaving site.

title_templates.text: Site Inspection and Survey
title_templates.description: Attend site to carry out the survey. Record measurements, access constraints, power availability and photographs, and return the findings for quotation.

internal_notes.description: Report to the site contact on arrival and sign in before starting. Record meter readings and asset serial numbers as you work, and photograph anything that will need a follow-up visit.
Access to the plant room is controlled. Collect the key from reception, return it before leaving site, and do not prop fire doors open while carrying equipment.
This visit involves work at height. Check the ladder or platform before use, wear the harness where anchor points exist, and do not work alone above two metres.
The reported fault may need a replacement part. Confirm the model and serial number on site and raise a parts request the same day so the return visit can be booked.
Obtain the customer signature on the service report before leaving site. If no authorised signatory is available, note the reason and inform the coordinator.

customer_notes.description: Our technician is scheduled to attend on the date shown. Please ensure the affected area is accessible and a site contact is available to grant entry.
To allow the work to proceed safely, please clear the area around the equipment before our technician arrives and isolate the supply if instructed.
A follow-up visit has been arranged to complete the outstanding work. The date and time are shown above and no further action is needed from you.
The replacement part required has been ordered. We will contact you to confirm a return visit as soon as it reaches our stores.
The scheduled work has been carried out and the equipment returned to service. Please contact us if the issue recurs.

term_conditions.description: Work is carried out during normal working hours, Monday to Friday. Attendance outside these hours is chargeable at the prevailing overtime rate. Parts and consumables are charged in addition unless covered by a maintenance contract.
Site access must be available at the agreed time. Visits cancelled with less than 24 hours notice, or aborted because access could not be granted, are chargeable at the full visit rate.

Workmanship is warranted for 90 days from the date of the visit. Parts supplied carry the manufacturer warranty only. The warranty is void where the equipment has been altered or serviced by a third party.
This visit is carried out under the terms of the active maintenance contract. Work falling outside the agreed scope will be quoted separately and requires written approval before it proceeds.
Invoices are payable within 30 days of issue. Amounts outstanding beyond that period may attract interest at the statutory rate, and further visits may be held pending settlement.
